summary: Katapult Holdings filed 8-K reporting amendments to its Merger Agreement and Stockholders Agreement dated June 17, 2026, modifying board composition terms related to its pending acquisition. The Merger Agreement originally set a nine-member board; amendments increase it to ten members and add Philip Bartow III to the class alongside Lynn DeVault, Gene Schutt, and Orlando Zayas. The Stockholders Agreement similarly adjusts board size and raises the threshold for further increases above ten directors to 80% approval for three years post-closing. These changes signal fine-tuning of governance before closing. The transaction involves the acquisition of CCF Holdings and Aaron's. No price per share, premium, or expected close date was disclosed. Watch for shareholder approval and regulatory clearance.
